description: Erection of a two storey side extension and erection of an outbuilding in rear garden for use as a Gym
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1313/01, 1313/02, 1313/03, 1313/04, 1313/05, 1313/06, and 1313/07 received: 15/04/2019. 1084/03 Rev B and 1313/08 Rev B received: 09/07/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used as a gym or other purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 111 Heath Road, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
